description: React component for the onboarding workspace preparation flow in Mattermost, managing steps like organization setup, plugins, invites, and workspace launching.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team with the given organization name, returns error message or new team.

methods.name: updateTeam
methods.description: Updates an existing team, returns error message or updated team.

methods.name: sendForm
methods.description: Handles form submission: sends invites, plugins setup, marks setup complete, and redirects to workspace.

methods.name: shouldShowPage
methods.description: Determines if a wizard step should be displayed based on current state.

methods.name: makeNext
methods.description: Advances to the next wizard step.

methods.name: redirectWithError
methods.description: Redirects to a specific step with an error message.

methods.name: getTransitionDirection
methods.description: Determines animation direction based on step transition.

methods.name: skipPlugins
methods.description: Sets whether plugins step is skipped.

methods.name: skipTeamMembers
methods.description: Sets whether invite members step is skipped.

methods.name: getInviteMembersAnimationClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class for invite members animation state.
